name: K92 Mining Inc.
summary: K92 Mining Inc. engages in the exploration and development of mineral deposits in Papua New Guinea. The company primarily produces gold, copper, and silver. The company's mineral properties include the Kainantu gold mine project that covers an area of approximately 830 square kilometers located in the Eastern Highlands province of Papua New Guinea; the Blue Lake gold-copper porphyry deposit located in Papua New Guinea; and Arakompa. The company was formerly known as K92 Holdings International Limited and changed its name to K92 Mining Inc. in May 2016. K92 Mining Inc. is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
